scope: 仅五类公开花卉图片分类原型，不是通用植物或物种鉴定服务；校园实拍与非目标开放集未验证。
strategy: frozen ImageNet feature extractor + trained multinomial linear classification head
split: SHA256 exact deduplication, dHash Hamming <= 4 connected groups, stratified 70/15/15 group allocation
head_selection: maximum validation macro F1; tie: smaller C

threshold.metric: maximum softmax score, not calibrated probability
threshold.selection: highest validation coverage meeting target; tie smaller threshold; if none threshold 1.0, report unmet target

model_selection: validation macro F1, then single-image CPU latency; test metrics never select model or threshold
test_policy: evaluate each fixed model once after hyperparameters, threshold and preferred model are frozen
